title: From Event Logs to Governed Action: A BlueSky Agenda for Agentic Process Mining
abstract: arXiv:2609.07984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process mining has long turned event logs into process knowledge: discovered models, conformance evidence, bottleneck diagnoses, and runtime predictions. Agentic AI changes the target. Process-aware agents will not only ask what happened. They will ask whether a proposed action should be taken, given the available evidence, privacy budget, organizational authority, and downstream risk. This BlueSky paper proposes event-to-action process mining: a process-mining agenda for transforming heterogeneous operational event data into governed action. The goal is not another dashboard, a generic enterprise simulator, or a language interface over logs. We argue that the community needs four mineable artifacts: event-object representations, action evidence packages, governance contracts, and benchmarks where act, defer, ask, and refuse are all valid outputs. translated_title: 从事件日志到受治理的行动：面向智能体流程挖掘的蓝景议程
translated_abstract: 流程挖掘长期以来一直将事件日志转化为流程知识：发现的模型、合规性证据、瓶颈诊断以及运行时预测。智能体AI改变了这一目标。具备流程感知能力的智能体将不仅仅询问“发生了什么”，而是会追问：在现有证据、隐私预算、组织权限和下游风险的约束下，某项提议的行动是否应该被执行。这篇BlueSky论文提出了“事件到行动的流程挖掘”：一个旨在将异构运营事件数据转化为受治理行动的流程挖掘研究议程。其目标既不是又一个仪表板，也不是通用的企业模拟器，更不是面向日志的语言交互界面。我们认为，该社区需要四种可挖掘的产物：事件-对象表示、行动证据包、治理合约，以及以“执行、延迟、询问、拒绝”皆为有效输出的基准测试。这一议程恰逢其时，因为智能体业务流程管理（BPM）和LLM辅助的流程……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出“事件到行动流程挖掘”的研究议程，主张将异构运营事件数据转化为受治理的行动决策，并呼吁社区构建事件-对象表示、行动证据包、治理合约以及“执行/延迟/询问/拒绝”皆为有效输出的基准测试这四种可挖掘产物。
en_tdlr: This BlueSky paper proposes an "event-to-action process mining" agenda for transforming heterogeneous operational event data into governed action, calling for four mineable artifacts: event-object representations, action evidence packages, governance contracts, and benchmarks where act, defer, ask, and refuse are all valid outputs.
